model_changes.refinement: Dated custom-research, recruitment and reader-access statements do not establish one evolving current offer. Sponsor-marked output is a separate observation.
model_changes.transfer_limit: Offer chronology is not a price/evolution or retention study.

model_changes.refinement: Research users and provider promotional licensees purchase different uses. Any practitioner-free and employer-paid overlap must be resolved in the actual Table bundle.
model_changes.transfer_limit: No import of analyst ratings, licence terms or achieved subscription economics.

model_changes.refinement: TPC renewal/access terms distinguish a contract mechanism from actual paid/useful continuation, with person/organisation/period boundaries. IPASS and GPA add geographic/task alternatives.
model_changes.transfer_limit: Do not copy auto-renewal, new terms or unlike prices into JGA.

model_changes.refinement: Keep research and peer layers distinct; any use of Chatham House language needs a specified meeting/output mode.
model_changes.transfer_limit: No automatic research licence, identifiable publication, recording or meeting-attendance publicity.

model_changes.refinement: CPO’s dated origins, forum and later issues show separate outputs. A May 2026 summit retrospective names Nick as moderator. This is public involvement, not Table access or a partnership agreement.
model_changes.transfer_limit: No same-member retention, formal collaboration, endorsement or free forum access inferred.

model_changes.refinement: Keep an event’s approved audience, commercial inventory, research fit, funding and delivery prerequisites distinct. Employer hospitality conditions can constrain who can attend.
model_changes.transfer_limit: Announced London event remains forthcoming on review; no actual attendance, funding timing or JGA sponsor conversion inferred.

conditions.name: Actual use and free/paid entitlement
conditions.question: Who uses the output for which actual decision, and what additional service or use right is being purchased?
conditions.application: Distinguish employer reading, supplier marketing, adviser client work and the research already promised free to contributors. Define incremental value and count the same entitlement once.
conditions.counterexample: A contributor receives the report free, then the model assumes their employer buys equivalent access as a separate licence.

conditions.name: Specific relationship and role
conditions.question: Is this organisation a source, substitute, public collaborator, distributor, service buyer or proposed funder in this particular exchange?
conditions.application: Use Nick’s documented moderator role and existing recruiter content/events as context. Verify a proposed current relationship or right separately; do not pre-fill a sponsor list.
conditions.counterexample: A public panel role becomes assumed audience access or a Table partnership, or all six recruiter comparators are treated as paying research prospects.

conditions.name: Programme, cohort and entitlement lifecycle
conditions.question: Which dated output, cohort, member role and access period are actually observed or agreed?
conditions.application: Separate a series of publications, an announced event, actual participation, contractual renewal, payment and useful continued engagement. Handle changed role/employer/period proportionately.
conditions.counterexample: Four different event cohorts become a longitudinal panel, or an auto-renewal clause becomes evidence of achieved retention.

conditions.name: Decision geography, alternatives and permitted participation
conditions.question: What country/operating scope and decision need does this user have, and can the relevant person participate in this format?
conditions.application: Compare actual UK/Irish/global support and public/internal alternatives. Event city alone does not determine research need. Separate eligible practitioner, permitted hospitality and useful research contribution.
conditions.counterexample: Dublin attendance interest becomes demand for global research; a person unable to accept hospitality is assumed irrelevant to remote or written research.

conditions.name: Meeting mode, recognition and publication
conditions.question: What meeting rule applies, and what specific recognition, research use or publication has been permitted?
conditions.application: If adopting the named Chatham House Rule, follow its current definition/FAQ. Do not treat optional recording permission or council recognition as permission to record a Rule meeting, identify attendance or attribute others’ comments.
conditions.counterexample: A consent checkbox silently overrides a no-recording meeting mode, or optional council recognition becomes an attendee list linked to a private remark.

conditions.name: Delivery-ready value, funds and attribution
conditions.question: Are the required evidence, people, rights, service capacity and cash available for the benefit actually promised?
conditions.application: Separate research and commercial-access benefits where combined. Preserve research/member fit beside funder targeting. Model direct licence revenue, servicing/distribution value and event increment separately without invented conversion or cash timing.
conditions.counterexample: Sponsor interest or payment is treated as proof that a permissioned report, relevant peer group and promised meetings are deliverable.
